title: PermissionRuleBatch
description: `POST /permission-rules/revoke` and `POST /permission-rules/restore`: several rules from one call, atomic in validation and in the write (plan 15, B-13, D-06, D-11) — every id is checked before anything is written, and the rules this call touched come back together, each the same shape `GET /permission-rules/:ruleId` returns.

rules.description: One entry per id given, in the same order — a rule already revoked (or already restored) is idempotent and still comes back.
